note: Public, unauthenticated Soulframe endpoints. Paths came from Launcher.log's own HTTP transcripts and EE.log error lines, then were probed. inventory.php and getShip.php are deliberately absent: both are session-authenticated, the app forbids credentials, so there is nothing to probe. Soulframe has NO PublicExport equivalent - the origin index is a client download manifest (binaries, language RTFs, Cache.Windows/*.toc) with no item exports.
